title: Invariant anticanonical sections under structure-sheaf acyclicity
exact_target: For a smooth connected projective complex X with smoothly semipositive $-K_X$ and $H^i(X,O_X)=0$ for all $i>0$, must every algebraic torus action admit a nonzero invariant section of some positive anticanonical power with its natural linearization?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
